notes.title: Foul Referee!
notes.content:
V0.5 is here featuring the following:
[list]
[*] Referees with varying levels of harshness
[*] Yellow/Red Cards
[*] Injuries
[*] Suspensions and injuries causing players to miss games in tournaments
[*] AI substitutions
[/list]

These features can be turned off in the settings if you prefer a good dirty slide tackle to go unpunished.

Most notable bug fix:
[*] Euro tournament bug fix when getting in to knockout stages causes issue.
